title: Evening at the dive centre
description: The Scuba Lak dive centre in the soft evening light, with Kadmat’s beach and lagoon close by.

title: Sunset through the palms
description: Kadmat’s beach at dusk, with the lagoon and a pink horizon framed by coastal trees and a hammock.

title: Before the first dive
description: A beginner prepares for a first scuba experience with the Scuba Lak team, taking time over equipment and the steps before entering the water.

title: Getting ready, one step at a time
description: A closer look at the preparation before a beginner’s dive in Kadmat, with the team alongside to guide the process.

title: A moment for the briefing
description: The team and guests pause for a pre-dive briefing before their time in Kadmat’s lagoon.

title: The dive begins with a conversation
description: A real pre-dive briefing with Scuba Lak: time to listen, ask questions and get ready together.

title: A lagoon, not a swimming pool
description: The remarkable clarity of Kadmat’s shallow lagoon, filmed from the water’s edge. These colours belong to the island itself.

title: Getting set at sea
description: Preparations aboard the dive boat before heading into the water off Kadmat. The boat is part of the day’s learning and teamwork.

title: On the way to the reef
description: A boat journey across Kadmat’s bright lagoon towards the reef, with open water and island views along the way.

title: An ordinary Kadmat evening
description: A quiet evening on Kadmat, when the light softens and island life settles into a slower rhythm.

title: Agatti from the water
description: Agatti Island seen from a vessel: a glimpse of the shoreline and lagoon on an island journey through Lakshadweep.

title: Time in the clear water
description: A relaxed moment in Kadmat’s clear lagoon, surrounded by the pale turquoise water that makes the island so memorable.

title: Embarkation at Amini
description: A view of embarkation at Amini Island, part of the everyday connection between Lakshadweep’s communities and the sea.

title: One-to-one preparation in the lagoon
description: An instructor and participant work through preparation together in Kadmat’s shallow lagoon before their dive.

title: Learning from the shore
description: Pre-dive training in Kadmat’s shallow water, with time to become familiar with the equipment before the dive.

title: The shore-side kit check
description: Scuba equipment prepared on Kadmat’s sand before a session, with the lagoon just a few steps away.

title: Equipment ready beneath the palms
description: Scuba cylinders and dive equipment lined up in the shade beside Scuba Lak, with Kadmat’s beach and lagoon beyond.

title: A little adjustment, a little confidence
description: An instructor helps a participant adjust their mask in Kadmat’s shallow lagoon during pre-dive preparation. Small, careful steps help a first experience feel more familiar.
